newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Rao arrested Wednesday, released on bail.
newsitem.headline: India's Rao arrested Wednesday, released on bail.

text.p: Federal police arrested former Indian prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in a criminal forgery case but he was immediately released on bail, the Press Trust of India said on Thursday.

Two officers of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) served an arrest warrant at Rao's New Delhi residence late on Wednesday, the news agency said. Rao immediately posted bond and was released, PTI said.
Last week, a judge issued a warrant for the arrest of Rao in the seven-year-old forgery case, one of two criminal cases involving the former prime minister.
Earlier on Wednesday, the Delhi High Court granted Rao pre-emptive, or anticipatory, bail until a hearing into the forgery case, which is set for next Monday.
The High Court set a personal bond of 25,000 rupees ($700) and a surety of the same amount.
PTI said the wife of former foreign minister Pranab Mukherjee, who served in Rao's cabinet until the Congress party lost elections in May, paid the bail.
